design_philosophy: Premium, Fast, Mobile-First. The design relies on 'Archetype 5: Luxury (Light Variant)'. We avoid chaotic bazaars and instead present an editorial, curated storefront. It utilizes stark contrasts, elegant serif typography for storytelling, and generous negative space to let multi-category products breathe.

headings.usage: Use tight letter-spacing (tracking-tighter) for large headings to maintain editorial elegance. Use for Product Titles, Section Headers, and Hero typography.

body.usage: Highly legible, geometric sans-serif for mobile readability. Use for pricing, product descriptions, pincode checks, and functional UI elements.

typography.labels_overlines: Uppercase, tiny text (text-xs), very wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) using Manrope.

colors.notes: Background is 'Warm Pearl' (not pure white) to reduce eye strain and feel expensive. Primary is 'Deep Emerald' (culturally signifies prosperity/wealth in India, avoids generic blue). Accent is 'Champagne Gold' for flash sales/badges.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/70 with a delicate 1px border-b border-[#E5E1D8]. Nav MUST be sticky with z-50.
surfaces.product_cards: Solid Pure White bg-[#FFFFFF] against the Pearl background. Flat, crisp 1px border. On hover, apply subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and diffuse shadow (shadow-xl shadow-black/5).
surfaces.pdp_bottom_bar: Mobile only: Fixed bottom bar bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t with full-width 'Buy Now' button.

visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px borders, subtle opacity (border-black/5 or border-[#E5E1D8]). Corners should be subtly rounded (rounded-md max 6px) to avoid looking childish.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows. Do not use heavy box-shadows on cards by default, only on hover or for floating elements.

layouts_and_grids.homepage: Bento Grid Mode A (Asymmetrical). Do not use standard equal grids. Mix 1 large hero banner, 2 square category highlights, and horizontal scrolling lists for 'New Arrivals'.
layouts_and_grids.category_page: Responsive Grid: grid-cols-2 (Mobile) to grid-cols-4 (Desktop). Sticky left sidebar for filters on Desktop. Horizontally scrollable filter pills on Mobile.
layouts_and_grids.product_page: Desktop: 2-column layout (Images sticky on left, Content scrolls on right). Mobile: Stacked. Images must support Pinch-Zoom. 'Pincode Check' must sit right above the Add to Cart button.
layouts_and_grids.cart_checkout: 1-column narrow flow for focus. Order Summary sticky on right (Desktop). Highlight GST and Delivery transparently.

components_strategy.buttons: Primary buttons (Buy Now, Checkout) must be solid Deep Emerald (#022C22) with text-white. Sharp styling (rounded-sm). Add hover:bg-[#064E3B] hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn standard inputs but customized: bg-transparent, border-b-2 border-black/20 (no full borders) for a cleaner, editorial form look.
components_strategy.navigation: Include search bar prominently. Desktop: Top-level categories visible. Mobile: Hamburger menu + horizontal scrollable sub-category chips just below header.
components_strategy.flash_sale: Do not use loud red banners. Use Champagne Gold (#C5A880) background with Black text, elegant Mono-spaced countdown timer.
components_strategy.pincode_check: Input group with 'Check' button inside. Success state shows green text 'Delivery by [Date]'. Error state shows red text.

motion.micro_interactions: All interactive elements MUST have hover and active states. Use Framer Motion for page transitions.
motion.image_galleries: Smooth cross-fade or snap-scroll for product images.
motion.loading: No spinners. Use skeleton screens matching the exact layout of the content.

accessibility.contrast: Deep Emerald on Pearl Background passes APCA effortlessly.
accessibility.touch_targets: Mobile-first: All buttons and links must be minimum 44x44px. 'Buy Now' must span full width on mobile.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='pincode-input', data-testid='buy-now-btn').

media.notes: Hero banner images MUST use an overlay gradient to preserve text readability (bg-gradient-to-r from-black/60 to-transparent).

pdp_specific.dynamic_attributes: Size and Color pickers must be visual. Color pickers as hex circles with ring on active. Size pickers as bordered square pills.
pdp_specific.pricing: Show INR (₹). If discounted, show strikethrough MRP in muted gray right next to the bold active price.
pdp_specific.return_policy: Render as an accordion (Shadcn Accordion) or prominent icon-text lockups near 'Add to Cart'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge
Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone) for a high-end, premium aesthetic.
Create dynamic pages for Homepage, Category Layout, Product Details (PDP), Cart, Checkout, and Dashboard.
Never use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components and customize their styles.
Ensure 'mobile-first' means horizontal scroll wrappers for categories on small screens instead of forcing everything into vertical stacks.
Maintain the Playfair + Manrope font setup. Inject them via Google Fonts in index.html or layout wrapper.
The header nav should be sticky and use Glassmorphism (Crystal variation, high saturation blur).
DO NOT output standard Vercel default look. Use the defined Warm Pearl background and Deep Emerald primary colors.
Implement the UI with pure functional frontend code (React components).
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than typical designs). Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
NEVER use placeholder images; use the provided image URLs.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Use sonner for toast notifications (for Cart additions, Checkout success, etc).
